evals.prompt: Create a small instruction-only skill named status-brief for turning rough project updates into a short status note. Preserve supplied names, dates, and figures; label missing information instead of inventing it. Include optional Codex UI metadata. I do not need helper scripts or a benchmarking framework.
evals.expected_output: A usable status-brief/SKILL.md and valid optional OpenAI metadata, proportionate to the stated scope.

assertions.text: The skill defines how to use supplied facts and handle missing information.
The agent creates the requested files without another approval pause.
Any OpenAI metadata has an interface mapping and exact skill invocation.
The result does not add unrequested helper scripts or an eval framework.

evals.prompt: Update the display name of this existing skill to Weekly Status, leaving its other UI values, explicit-only policy, dependencies, and SKILL.md unchanged.
evals.expected_output: A narrow update preserving all unrelated settings and files.

assertions.text: The existing explicit-only invocation policy and dependency values are preserved.

evals.prompt: We keep doing the same vendor onboarding review: find missing intake details and prepare a decision note. Would this be worth capturing as a reusable skill? I have not decided to create it yet.
evals.expected_output: A short proposal explaining the job, trigger, expected output, and value before file creation.

assertions.text: The agent proposes the skill without creating it.

evals.prompt: Review this draft skill and improve unclear instructions. This environment has no independent agent runner. Give me the revised files and an honest account of what you checked.
evals.expected_output: A supported revision with structural or author walkthrough checks clearly separated from unrun benchmarks.

assertions.text: The result does not claim a measured baseline or host-trigger score without observations.

evals.prompt: Our invoice reconciliation skill keeps activating when I only ask for a reminder email about an invoice. Review its description and propose cases that test this boundary. Do not claim host measurements until we run them.
evals.expected_output: A precise trigger revision with realistic positive and near-miss negative cases, labelled as unrun.

assertions.text: The proposed tests distinguish reconciling data from writing payment reminders.
Expected labels are kept separate from observed triggering.

evals.prompt: Our skill asks for confirmation before every file edit and keeps rerunning all checks after they pass. Audit it for a newer model while preserving the deployment approval and required integration test.
evals.expected_output: Remove redundant process while retaining the actual deployment boundary and required validation.

assertions.text: The revision distinguishes authorized local edits from deployment authorization.
The required integration check remains in the workflow.
The agent does not promise better performance on untested models.
